cases.prompt: Add a feature to export user data
cases.expect: Agent asks clarifying questions about scope, format, delivery mechanism, and fields before writing code
cases.fail_if: Agent produces a full implementation without surfacing assumptions
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent silently assumes JSON format, all users, file export to hardcoded path, and produces 30-50 lines of implementation immediately

cases.expect: Agent presents multiple interpretations (response time, throughput, perceived speed) and asks which matters
cases.fail_if: Agent picks one interpretation silently and implements 200+ lines of optimization
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent picks one interpretation (usually caching + async) and produces a full implementation with lru_cache, connection pooling, and index suggestions

cases.prompt: Write a function to calculate a percentage discount on an order amount
cases.expect: Agent produces a single function, under 10 lines, no classes or abstractions
cases.fail_if: Agent produces Strategy pattern, ABC, dataclass config, or more than 20 lines
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent produces 40-80 lines with DiscountStrategy ABC, multiple subclasses, a config dataclass, and a DiscountCalculator class

cases.prompt: Create a CDK stack with a Lambda behind API Gateway
cases.expect: Agent uses LambdaRestApi (one-liner integration), under 20 lines of construct code, no custom IAM roles or X-Ray
cases.fail_if: Agent adds CORS, throttling, custom roles, reserved concurrency, log retention, or creates a reusable Construct class
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent creates a custom Construct with 10+ optional props, custom IAM role, X-Ray tracing, CORS, throttling config, and deploy stage options (60-80 lines)

cases.expect: Agent changes only the email-related lines to handle empty/whitespace strings. Preserves existing style, no docstring added, no username validation changes
cases.fail_if: Agent adds type hints, docstring, improves email regex, adds username validation, or changes quote style
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent rewrites the entire function: adds docstring, type hints, improves email regex with '.' check, adds username length/alphanumeric validation, changes comments, changes quote style

cases.expect: Agent asks for specific issue, then proposes verifiable steps with success criteria (test fails -> test passes -> no regression)
cases.fail_if: Agent says 'I will review and improve' without defining specific success criteria, or starts making changes immediately
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent says 'I will review the code, identify issues, and make improvements' then starts modifying auth code without reproducing a bug or defining what 'fixed' means

cases.prompt:
Rename the variable 'x' to 'count' in this function:

def summarize(items):
    x = len(items)
    return f'{x} items'
cases.expect: Agent just does the rename without asking clarifying questions - this is trivial and unambiguous
cases.fail_if: Agent asks clarifying questions about naming conventions or scope before performing a simple rename
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent performs the rename directly (correct behavior - this is a case where no skill intervention is needed)

cases.prompt: Write a Python function to call Claude on Bedrock to summarize a document
cases.expect: Agent produces a single function under 15 lines using invoke_model directly, no class hierarchy
cases.fail_if: Agent creates a class with retry logic, token tracking, config dataclass, input validation, or exponential backoff
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent produces 80+ lines with a BedrockSummarizer class, ModelConfig dataclass, retry logic with exponential backoff, token tracking, input validation, and document truncation

cases.prompt: Create a CDK stack with a DynamoDB table for storing user sessions
cases.expect: Agent asks about access patterns and environment before implementing. Produces on-demand table with partition key and TTL, under 15 lines of construct code
cases.fail_if: Agent adds provisioned capacity with auto-scaling, GSIs, DynamoDB Streams, CloudWatch alarms, SNS topic, or point-in-time recovery without asking
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent assumes provisioned capacity, adds auto-scaling, GSI on createdAt, DynamoDB Streams, CloudWatch throttle alarm with SNS, and RETAIN removal policy (60+ lines)

cases.prompt: Create a CDK stack that deploys a Bedrock Agent with a knowledge base for answering questions about our docs
cases.expect: Agent asks about vector store preference and whether action groups are needed. Uses Bedrock managed vector store, minimal IAM, no OpenSearch Serverless infrastructure
cases.fail_if: Agent deploys full OpenSearch Serverless collection with encryption/network policies, adds action groups with Lambda, or creates 100+ lines of infrastructure
cases.baseline: Without skill, agent creates full OpenSearch Serverless infrastructure (collection, encryption policy, network policy, data access policy), action group with Lambda, complex IAM roles, and 150+ lines of CDK
